Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz && cat > /tmp/mkfuzz.py <<'PY'
import sys, struct

def wint(v, size=4):
    out = b''
    for i in range(size):
        out = bytes([(v >> (8*(size-1-i))) & 0xff]) + out
    # xmlFuzzWriteInt writes big-endian: shift=size*8, then while shift>0: shift-=8; putc((v>>shift)&255)
    # Actually re-read: it writes high byte first. Let me match xmlFuzzReadInt which does ret=(ret<<8)|c.
    # So bytes are big-endian. Build big-endian:
    out = b''
    for i in range(size):
        out += bytes([(v >> (8*(size-1-i))) & 0xff])
    return out

def wstr(s):
    # backslash-newline terminated; escape backslash by doubling
    out = b''
    for c in s:
        b = c if isinstance(c, int) else ord(c)
        out += bytes([b])
        if b == ord('\\'):
            out += bytes([b])
    out += b'\\\n'
    return out

def make(opts, maxalloc, url, entity):
    data = wint(opts, 4) + wint(maxalloc, 4)
    data += wstr(url) + wstr(entity)
    return data

if __name__ == '__main__':
    opts = int(sys.argv[1], 0) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
    maxalloc = int(sys.argv[2], 0) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0
    url = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "a"
    entity = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "<a/>"
    out = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else "/tmp/fuzz.bin"
    data = make(opts, maxalloc, url, entity)
    open(out, "wb").write(data)
    print("wrote", len(data), "bytes to", out)
PY
